summary: Assess financial risks, test controls and document audit evidence. Strengthen your financial audit practice with this five-day course.
lede: Financial risk management for auditors helps internal and financial auditors and audit managers assess exposure and test financial controls. Learners build risk assessments, map risks to controls, plan evidence-based tests, analyze exceptions and root causes, and document findings and follow-up actions while considering residual exposure against risk tolerance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess financial exposure, test financial controls or oversee risk-based audit work. It suits intermediate learners with working familiarity with financial processes or internal audit evidence.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with financial processes or internal audit work is recommended. No programming is required. Spreadsheet-based exercises assume basic spreadsheet use.
